state:
**Goal `completion-files`, Stage 3 is green and Stage 4 is two thirds done.** Every test both Stage 3 checks name is in `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion_file_values.rs` and passes. The earlier single test is split into the names the check gives, and two of them are new: an inherited method reached through its declaring class, and a path parameter offered both lists.

A path or class-name parameter now gets a completion file's values beside its own entries (`values_beside` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs`, module doc § *What a completion file offers*). `continues_a_trigger` opens a value's separator there too.

Stage 4: `hover::at` and `definition::at` take `&CompletionFiles` (server passes the loaded set, the `.lspt` suite an empty one). A literal equal to a value hovers as its `title` and documentation, and goes to its `location`'s line. A matched value with no `location` has no definition, and does not fall through to the method. Both are in the module docs of `hover.rs` and `definition.rs`, and three of the Stage 4 check's nine tests pass.

The strict check, the Deprecated hint and its quick fix (the other six Stage 4 tests), the literal union (Stage 5) and the VS Code schema (Stage 6) are not written.

next.title: hover, go-to-definition, the strict check and the replacement

items.text: **The strict check** (`rule:ide/completion-files-offer-values-at-named-parameters` § *What else reads it*). Built where a document's diagnostics are, `crates/nvs-lsp/src/diagnostics.rs:140`. Walk the entry's string literal arguments with `crate::arguments::named_at`'s naming, and warn where any attachment is `strict`, no `when` is undecided, and the cooked text is no value of `CompletionFiles::values_at` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion_files.rs:420`). This needs a new W code in `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` beside W1013–W1019. `for_document` takes no `&CompletionFiles` yet. Tests `a_strict_parameter_warns_on_a_literal_that_is_not_one_of_its_values`, `a_strict_parameter_does_not_check_a_value_built_at_run_time`, `a_strict_check_is_skipped_where_a_when_cannot_be_decided` and `a_parameter_without_strict_reports_nothing`.

**The Deprecated hint and its quick fix** — the same walk in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/diagnostics.rs:140`, a hint with the `Deprecated` tag on a literal equal to a deprecated value, carrying the `replacement`, escaped for the literal's quote, as its `Suggestion` so `crates/nvs-lsp/src/actions.rs:118` offers it unchanged (`rule:ide/a-code-action-ships-only-a-fix-a-diagnostic-already-knows`). Tests `a_literal_equal_to_a_deprecated_value_gets_a_deprecated_hint` and `the_replacement_quick_fix_rewrites_only_the_string_and_escapes_for_its_quote`.

backlog: Stage 5: a parameter typed as a union of string literals completes its members, merged by value with a completion file's (goal § Stage 5).
Stage 6: `editors/vscode/schemas/completion-file.json` and its client registration (goal § Stage 6).
Stage 7: the feature proofs for completion files (`bun nv proofs --id`).
A value with no `title` and no documentation hovers as whatever the walk over the nodes answers (`hover.rs` module doc); the Stage 4 check names no test for it.
